name: enhancecv
description: EnhanceCV — Build a better CV for every job. Truthful, job-specific resume tailoring with transparent ATS analysis.

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix web
